article.title: Why Pentagon is the central axis of the U.S.-Venezuela oil deal
article.author: Editor
article.content: According to the fact sheet published by the White House on August 31, the Office of Strategic Capital of the Pentagon (renamed the Department of War) will own 35% of the shares of the company North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP), selected by the Trump administration to lead oil extraction projects in Venezuelan fields with a proven potential of 65 billion barrels. The post Why Pentagon is the central axis of the U.S.-Venezuela oil deal appeared first on MR Online .
